items.stem: Which sentence best describes how AI usually learns to tell cats from dogs?

options.text: It looks at many example pictures and finds patterns that tell them apart
options.rationale: Correct: modern AI learns patterns from lots of examples (data).

options.text: Someone types in every single rule about every cat
options.rationale: AI usually learns from examples rather than every hand-typed rule.

options.text: It already knows everything when it is built
options.rationale: AI must learn from data; it does not know everything at the start.

options.text: It asks the cat and the dog
options.rationale: AI learns from example data, not by asking animals.
